title: The Age-Gap Market: Hollywood’s Most Public Preference Pattern
primaryKeyword: Hollywood age gap dating pattern data
audience: Readers who want the DiCaprio meme turned into a market-structure report — power, pipelines, and public data — not slut-shaming or fan war.
metaDescription: Treat Hollywood’s public age-gap dating patterns as a market: pipelines from modeling, power asymmetry, and what the viral DiCaprio chart actually measures.
angle: The internet already made the chart. Artometrics asks what system produces repeatedly public pairings with large age asymmetries — casting/modeling pipelines, status asymmetry, and preference that stays legal while remaining structurally telling. DiCaprio is the calibration case, not the only case. Connect lightly to Playboy’s access mythology without claiming criminality.
